headline: Graphic Designer
tagline: Graphic designer with experience building digital and print creatives, brand identities, and scalable design templates.

skills.label: Design Tools
skills.items: Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, CorelDRAW

skills.label: Core Competencies
skills.items: Branding and visual identity, typography, layout, print production, social/marketing creative, design systems

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Collaborated with HR and management stakeholders, maintaining low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready files focusing on bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy while applying typography and layout systems.
Leveraged AI-assisted workflows using ChatGPT and Adobe Firefly for ideation and exploration.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Designed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Worked with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff using Photoshop and Illustrator.
Conducted usability testing and applied findings to user flows and interface usability.

projects.name: Branding Kit for AT Creation Startup
bullets: Developed comprehensive logo, typography, and color palette systems for early-stage business identity.

projects.name: Social Campaign for Fashion Brand
bullets: Executed an Instagram and Facebook series that achieved a 15% increase in follower engagement.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her extensive hands-on experience in digital and print creatives, brand identity systems, and template creation at Ascent Business Solutions to directly match Haber's visual design requirements.
omitted: Framer, Webflow, Miro, Notion, wireframing, prototyping, and responsive design — omitted as they are UX skills less relevant to a pure Graphic Designer posting.
Bounceless UX case study — omitted as the target role is Graphic Design rather than Product/UX Design.
